microbial ecosystems have a great impact on sedimentation.

the study of the impact of microbial ecosystems on the formation of sedimentary structures and the genesis of sedimentary rocks.

microbial communities play an important role in sedimentary environments and that their impact on sedimentary structures and processes has been underestimated in the past.

the study of microbial ecosystems and their impact on the formation of sediments is an exciting and challenging field.
